20 hours of its exercise, an hour a day, would take it from 74 to about 76. On your recent work, judged again as you are now, that’s forecast to be worth about 0.4 points a piece (your last 3 pieces all call on it; Postmarked Thursday (The Sister’s Messenger), Taped would gain most, about +0.5). Spaced pays more once your last session is a day to a week old. About as useful: Focus. Either is a sound next step.
